blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-01 at Plasma block 33899322: EIP-1967 binds the canonical proxy to YuzuUSDV3 at 0x8e02392855a51d9d5d18d71a7cfc731f56c68ea5. Verified V3 source routes mint/redemption configuration and NAV setters to a facet and tracks same-block received shares for redemption eligibility. Its inherited V2 burn function burns the caller's own tokens subject to BURNER_ROLE. The issuer discloses Hypernative blocking protocol interactions and Sentinel executing withdrawals from the Fordefi wallet; those disclosures do not establish interception of ordinary holder transfers. The August 8 source review remains historical, not a current V3 exclusion. Upstream backing controls remain distinct from native holder access. Possible is retained pending issuer legal terms and a complete mapping of operational controls to the holder-token execution path.

oracleRisk.summary: At Plasma block 33896709, yzUSD uses the YuzuUSDV3 implementation. Mint and redemption conversions apply a stored NAV capped at par. Its configured facet gates setNav and setNavUpdateInProgress with NAV_MANAGER_ROLE; NAV changes normally have a one-day cooldown and 10% step cap, with markdown-step exemptions. The live NAV was 1e18 and navLastUpdate was zero. This is a privileged top-level internal valuation path, not an oracleless product; no external feed or borrower-specific liquidation branch is identified in this path. The from-deployment grant census found no active NAV_MANAGER_ROLE recipients at this block. On-chain getRoleAdmin assigns NAV_MANAGER_ROLE to ADMIN_ROLE, held by the 12-hour manager timelock 0x5f3d29ef17700f8658c566dac7fbd76e0d86b78c, which can grant the pricing role.

branchApplicability.rationale: The verified V3 code applies a stored NAV to pooled mint and redemption conversions. It delegates the role-gated NAV setter to a configured facet; this is a top-level token valuation authority rather than borrower-specific collateral-price liquidation branches. The current review does not rely on the prior unsupported 110% redemption-ratio assertion.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: yzUSD's only material deployment is native issuance on Plasma. DefiLlama still reports ~24 yzUSD on a legacy Monad LayerZero OFT (0x9dcB0D17eDDE04D27F387c89fECb78654C373858), but peers(eid) returns zero for all probed endpoint ids on the Monad OFT (re-verified 2026-07-20 at block 88919965) and Yuzu announced it replaced LayerZero with Chainlink CCIP as its exclusive cross-chain infrastructure. The dormant Monad residue is inventoried as a reviewed subthreshold retired route and excluded from material tiering.
